verdict.rationale: GitLab's first-party Duo Agent Platform documents agentic Chat that takes natural-language requests. It can find merge requests without exact IDs, has project context across issues, MRs, commits and pipelines, and can propose and implement solutions. Chat is available in the GitLab UI, IDEs and the Duo CLI, with human-in-the-loop approvals and agents that turn issues into MRs. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language control works in practice, and documentation of how far Chat can operate the product beyond search, code changes and MR workflows (e.g. admin or settings actions).
